text: ___ sampling, combined with WHAM (the weighted histogram analysis method), reconstructs a potential of mean force by applying harmonic restraints at multiple positions along a reaction coordinate and combining the overlapping window distributions.
explanation: Umbrella sampling applies biasing harmonic restraints across a series of windows along a reaction coordinate; WHAM (or MBAR) then combines the overlapping sampled distributions into a single potential of mean force, used in applications such as ion channel permeation or membrane insertion studies.
